title: Xanthe and the Postcards
author: Sebastian Ravensworth
blurb: Juniper Whitlock, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
